summary: Residents tell a board what they call a hill that has no name in its federal entry.
realLife: Torrey residents identified the Utah feature as Torrey Knoll and objected to calling it a sentinel. The applicant withdrew the proposal.
inGame: needs: testimony of local usage and the status of the applicant’s proposal.

turns.what: The applicant withdraws the competing proposal.
turns.pulledBy: Residents supply an established local name.
turns.writesBack: The docket closes without adopting the proposed name..
